footballforge.question: How do you turn availability into a fair, usable match plan?
footballforge.intro: Matchday is a chain of small decisions. A coach needs to know who is coming, which positions are covered and what changes after the first substitution. FootballForge brings that chain together for youth teams, with team-specific training schedules and a shared planning workspace.
capabilities: Before kick-off
Maintain the squad, record attendance exceptions and select guest players for a particular match. Regular players and guests follow different availability rules.
Four moments, one match
The documented planner produces a starting formation and three substitution views. Manual changes recalculate the later lineups and substitution text.
Take the plan to the pitch
A local four-page PDF puts each formation and its substitutions on a separate page. The parent-message workflow also supports match communication and a downloadable poster.
decisions: Keep team changes scoped

The documented Supabase workflow merges the selected team's changes against the latest shared state using an updated_at comparison. This addresses one team's edits overwriting another team's data; it does not make browser access codes secure authentication.
Protect against an empty cloud response

The source documentation describes a browser recovery copy and a warning when remote data contains less team content than the local copy. The coach decides which version to retain. Production recovery has not been exercised by this showcase.
Generate artifacts locally

lineup-engine.js handles formation decisions, matchday-pdf.js produces the PDF and parent-message.js prepares communications. The showcase demo uses fictional players and never connects to these team records.
next: Verify concurrent edits and recovery on controlled test teams.
Complete real authentication and team-scoped access before broader use.
Review phone and print workflows with coaches.
related: safeforge
Both turn preparation into a plan people can use.
studyforge
Both organize repeatable routines and make progress visible.
footballforge.limits: These explanations follow the public repository documentation. Live team data, synchronization and player records were not accessed. Product screenshots are not available for publication.

studyforge.question: What makes the next practice session easier to start?
studyforge.intro: StudyForge connects published learning material with short, repeatable practice. Learners can work through questions, revisit mistakes and use flashcards; planning and goals give the next session a purpose. The learning content is prepared outside the app and published as a library.
capabilities: Practice with feedback
The documented experience includes multiple-choice questions, open questions with self-assessment, practice history and a way to revisit mistakes.
Remember through repetition
Flashcards offer a second way to work with material. The sample here demonstrates recall and reveal without recording a learner's results.
Choose the next step
Learning goals, practice planning and readiness views support a personal routine. The app reads published test dates; it does not provide an in-app authoring or import screen.
decisions: Separate publishing from learning

data.js loads the public content library; app.js presents learning activities and studytools.js supports goals and planning. Stable collection IDs keep results associated with the same material when content is updated.
Keep a static front end

HTML, CSS and JavaScript are hosted on GitHub Pages. The documented shared-progress adapter uses a limited Supabase database function. A configured adapter is not evidence of a verified live connection.
Treat access and privacy separately
The documented profile-code screen is not strong authentication. This world therefore uses only synthetic demo questions, with no student names, results, profile codes or production database calls.
next: Verify shared progress between controlled test sessions.
Review keyboard and assistive-technology use during practice.
Improve access controls before extending beyond the intended private use.
related: fascination-files
Curiosity can become a question worth practicing.
footballforge
Small routines support learning and team preparation alike.
studyforge.limits: The documentation describes the product and its cloud adapter; no private learning data or live database was accessed. The local demo does not synchronize results.

fascination-files.question: What turns a surprising question into a story worth following?
fascination-files.intro: The Fascination Files is the creative edge of the Forge: curiosity-led, visual storytelling around science, history, space, technology, nature and mystery. The published destination is Instagram. This world explains its editorial direction without representing invented stories as published work.
capabilities: A question comes first
The existing project catalog describes a discovery-led approach: start with a remarkable subject, then build a clear visual story around it.
A visual way into an idea
Cinematic presentation is part of the project's identity. The artwork in this showcase is an illustrative treatment, not an Instagram capture.
Continue at the source
Open the original Instagram profile to see its available published material. No feed is scraped, mirrored or presented as live here.
decisions: Explain the editorial direction honestly

The workflow above summarizes the existing NOVYX catalog. A public content-production repository was not available, so this page does not claim a particular publishing pipeline, automation service or production schedule.
Separate illustration from evidence

Illustrative previews communicate a visual direction. They do not establish that a particular story was published, researched or reviewed. Specific posts should be added only with a checked original link and permission to reuse their media.
Let discovery connect the worlds
Knowledge is a shared interest with StudyForge; technology experiments connect this creative world to Spark Lab. These are editorial connections between projects, not product integrations.
next: Curate a small set of original posts with verified links and media rights.
Add source notes to future story breakdowns.
Explore an accessible text companion for selected visual stories.
related: studyforge
Turn curiosity into a learning routine.
spark-lab
Turn an interesting question into an experiment.
fascination-files.limits: The Instagram profile could not be independently read during this review. No specific published posts, audience figures or posting frequency are claimed. Future editorial ideas are proposals.

safeforge.question: How can a complex planning event become a sequence of clear decisions?
safeforge.intro: SAFe Agile Forge combines role-based ceremony preparation with a PI Event Command Center. Its browser-based approach brings dates, responsibilities, readiness and event artifacts into a workspace that can be used without a hosted planning backend.
capabilities: Start with your responsibility
The documented role paths cover RTE, Product Manager, Product Owner and Scrum Master. Select ceremonies, enter iteration dates and preview a proposed calendar.
Prepare the whole event
The PI planner documents ART and team context, a two-day program, capacity and overlap checks, objectives, dependencies, ROAM risks and confidence records.
Make the plan portable
The repository describes calendar, PDF, XLSX and JSON outputs. Calendar files require an explicit import; they do not automatically send invitations.
decisions: Local-first planning has a boundary

Event state is stored per browser in localStorage, with JSON backup/import. The static architecture avoids server setup but does not provide synchronized multi-organizer editing or centralized RSVP collection.
Exports are deliberate handoffs
Offline artifacts let an organizer review and share a plan. The RSVP workflow requires the participant to send an email or export a CSV; displaying a form does not mean the response was delivered.
A planning aid needs human judgment

Readiness markers, business value and confidence controls record proposed planning information. They are not organizational signoff. The source documentation leaves full browser and cross-device acceptance open.
next: Complete end-to-end browser acceptance for planning and exports.
Review generated documents against the intended event workflow.
Evaluate multi-organizer collaboration only with an explicit backend design.
related: footballforge
Both translate preparation into practical, printable plans.
spark-lab
Both help structure an idea before execution.
sources: SAFe Agile Forge capabilities and architectural limits
safeforge.limits: Prototype implementation is documented in source. Hosting availability and organizational acceptance are separate checks. No Microsoft 365 or organizational-system integration is claimed.

wow-lifeforge.question: What remains of an adventure after the session ends?
wow-lifeforge.intro: LifeForge approaches Warcraft as a personal history: recorded milestones, memories, observed companions and places visited. It is a native Lua addon for the intended Forever client, with a local data model. Its public source is an alpha, not a confirmed in-game release.
capabilities: Record the journey
Build 7 documents character history, replay-safe milestone tiers and an observed zone atlas. History starts from recorded events; it cannot reconstruct adventures from before installation.
Keep the human moments
The source describes memories, favorites, future-self letters and a Memory Museum. These are implemented source features whose actual in-client behavior still requires validation.
Make room for real life
The related Forge AFK — Dad Mode repository documents twelve AFK reasons, a timer, silent mode and a return action. Its v1.0.0-beta.2 build also awaits game-client testing and CurseForge release.
decisions: Local records, meaningful evidence

LifeForge uses WoW SavedVariables and a versioned LF2 backup format. It records observed history instead of inventing old milestones. There is no companion website account or cloud character synchronization.
A test double is not a game client
The Build 7 README reports headless Lua and archive tests. They exercise logic but cannot establish rendering, combat behavior, API compatibility or reload persistence inside the real Forever client.
Keep distribution explicit

GitHub provides source and development evidence. The showcase offers no addon ZIP download; public releases and updates belong on a verified CurseForge page after client acceptance. Neither addon has a verified CurseForge release in this review.
next: Validate the target client interface and game API behavior.
Verify UI, combat restrictions and persistence after reload.
Confirm license and distribution gates before a public CurseForge release.

Two gaming worlds, focused on different kinds of player decisions.

wow-lifeforge.limits: LifeForge 0.8.0-alpha and Forge AFK v1.0.0-beta.2 are source-development snapshots. Game-client operation, screenshots and public CurseForge downloads remain unverified.

wildrift-counter.question: Which information matters while the draft clock is running?
wildrift-counter.intro: Wild Rift Counter starts with the lane and the opposing picks. Its purpose is to narrow a drafting question quickly, while recognizing that a solo matchup and a duo lane ask different things of a player. The Forge's sandbox demonstrates that decision flow with clearly labeled examples.
capabilities: Begin with the lane
The catalog describes Baron, Jungle, Mid, ADC and Support selection. A focused starting point reduces the number of unrelated choices.
Think about the pair
The existing project workflow and sample demo distinguish solo opponents from ADC/support pairs. Duo-lane context matters to the question being asked.
Use judgment after a suggestion
The local demo provides illustrative drafting considerations. It does not expose live win rates, current-patch counter rankings or a verified team-composition engine.
decisions: Bound the claims to the evidence

The public README identifies a smart Wild Rift draft assistant. The existing NOVYX catalog and reviewed development history provide the lane-first and duo-lane context. A framework, scoring algorithm or live data provider is not inferred from that description.
Keep examples separate from advice

The browser sandbox uses fixed demonstration choices. Its answers explain a draft interaction; they are not statistical recommendations. A production counter guide needs a checked patch, documented evidence and a maintained data workflow.
Leave room for the rest of the team
Team composition is a useful future dimension, but the current showcase does not present a complete composition optimizer as an implemented capability.
next: Verify a public application address and end-to-end draft flow.
Document matchup data provenance and patch-review dates.
Investigate team-composition context as a proposed extension.
related: wow-lifeforge
Explore another gaming project built around the player experience.
footballforge
Compare digital draft decisions with a real matchday lineup.
wildrift-counter.limits: The public application address remains unverified. No patch-current counters, performance statistics or official Riot endorsement are claimed.

spark-lab.question: What is the smallest useful version of an idea?
spark-lab.intro: Spark Lab is a working browser workshop. Describe an idea, its audience and the problem, then take away a structured brief, starting steps and a reusable build prompt. It uses deterministic templates, not a remote AI model.
capabilities: Frame the problem
Capture an idea and optional context in the existing workshop.
Make the first brief
Generate a structured starting point in your browser.
Take it with you
Copy the prompt or download the brief as JSON.
decisions: Make an experiment useful
The workshop runs in static HTML and JavaScript without a paid API or backend. Its output is a starting point for human review, not a validated feasibility assessment.
Keep the handoff visible
Visitors explicitly copy or download their brief. The page does not claim to create a repository, contact an AI service or submit an idea to NOVYX.
next: Explore reusable brief templates as an Idea Vault concept.
Evaluate prompt iteration with a clear local history model.
related: safeforge
From a clear brief to structured preparation.
fascination-files
Start an experiment with a question worth asking.
spark-lab.limits: The local workshop is a template-driven tool. It does not perform AI inference or publish your idea.
